sentences.text: I kept watch all night, and the humidity in the laundry room was lower than expected between 03:00 and 03:20.
The air in the laundry room was observed at 33.6 %, which was below the expected range of 36.2 % to 40.3 %.
Since the air seems to be drying out quickly, perhaps checking the laundry room ventilation might help.
